text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, good morning, Trainer. 
Out for a walk?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I stopped by a martial arts shop 
yesterday. 
I bought a few more practice swords.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—...Yes. 
Good. It fits my grip well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now that body and mind are centered— 
I look forward to working with you today, 
Trainer.
